other_conditions: The applicant must be a bonafide resident of Himachal Pradesh
The applicant must be a student studying from 9th grade up to university level
The applicant must belong to an Integrated Rural Development Program (IRDP) or BPL family
The applicant must be studying in a Government or Government‑aided institution in Himachal Pradesh
The applicant must have a bank account
benefits_summary: Scholarships of up to ₹2,400 per month, with amounts varying by class and gender.
